item.title: Koiyasumi Encore! ~Lovely Golden Week~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: RE:creation
  • 発売日: 2022-04-29
  • スコア: 6.75/10 (20 人評価)
  • 日本語名: コイヤスミEncore！～ラブリーゴールデンウィーク～
  • 英語名: Koiyasumi Encore! Lovely Golden Week

别名

  • Koiyasumi Encore! Lovely Golden Week

あらすじ

Four months have passed since that winter vacation… Now, Hiroki was watching Usaki in her swimsuit frolicking in the heated pool of a resort hotel. It’s Golden Week!

The main character, Hiroki Izumo, has come to a northern resort with his childhood friend and now girlfriend, Usaki Inaba. He invites her on a vacation as a reward for her hard work on her exams.

item.title: Koiyasumi ~Yuudachi ni Nureta Osananajimi~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: RE:creation
  • 発売日: 2021-08-27
  • スコア: 6.82/10 (134 人評価)
  • 日本語名: コイヤスミ ～夕立に濡れた幼馴染み～
  • 英語名: Koiyasumi Yuudachi ni Nureta Osananajimi

别名

  • Koiyasumi Yuudachi ni Nureta Osananajimi

あらすじ

The protagonist, Izumo Hiroki, is a university student who is tired of living in the city. He returns home to the countryside during the summer holidays. His parents have left the countryside and only his grandmother remains at home.

Incidentally, Hiroki’s presence always seems to bring rain. Today, too, the skies were overcast from the moment he got off the train. He headed for his parents’ house as fast as he could and barely evaded the evening showers. When he returned home, he met his soaking wet childhood friend, Inaba Usaki.
